column1: # Final timing protocol, a2 (2026-10-17): 4 x Intel Xeon Gold 5218 (x86-64, Cascade Lake), 64 cores in 4 NUMA nodes, no GPU, no pinning (64 cores in all).
# 20,001,073 HG002 reads (single-end, R1) or pairs; SAM to /dev/null; one session; single-end: three rounds, tools in turn; paired: one run each. Build: commit 80646c3 (g++ 13.3 -O3 -march=native).
# certa-cpu: CERTA streams its uncertified reads into minibwa, both concurrent (config = CERTA:minibwa threads; single-end minibwa -K 10m; paired: minibwa's default batch (Kdefault) or -K 10m).
# certa-cpu-iv: interval mode (--intervals), no fallback. certa-cpu-tier: certified reads only, not a complete mapping. Script: final_bench.sh (a2:~/certa-bench/cpu/).
